notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for object-registration service boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, ordinary FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and federation identity. It verifies pre-connect and pre-join failures, standard object publication and subscription, registration and discovery identity, local deletion, and post-deletion lookup boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador connection, federation membership, object-class and attribute lookup, object publication, object subscription, object registration, object identity lookup, local deletion, resignation, and federation destruction services with FederateAmbassador discovery callback
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador object-registration declarations and FederateAmbassador discovery callback
